author: gbolahan
content:
Hello, I just published v0.2.0 of eth-state-diff. Exhaustive

A huge shoutout to <@602753420033785856> (Lighthouse) for initial feedback from Lighthouse integration

If your client uses persistent/tree-backed structures (like Grandine's PersistentList), you will need to materialize flat views before calling create(). For a 32-epoch window, this is an acceptable cost for disk archival, but it means this library is optimized for the disk layer, not live state transitions.

• create on flat arrays down to ~75ms
• apply on flat arrays down to ~14ms

Repo: https://github.com/galadd/eth_state_diff
Crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/eth-state-diff

I'm especially interested in hearing from anyone integrating against tree-backed state structures, as that's the an area I'd like to explore for potential optimization but I'm not opposed to other types. Let me know how it goes
